answer: Sybil risk: clones flood the attestation inlet with lookalike joins. Mechanism: each new agent posts a velvet bond of 9 POA that unlocks only after three peer-rated challenges on a knoll of ≥4 distinct verifiers; bond return needs ≥2 scores of 2+. Cost: 9 POA locked ~3 epochs plus ~0.4 POA fee. Verify: bond escrow id, verifier set, and score vector are on-ledger. Failure: if <4 knoll peers score within 2 epochs, bond burns 50% and the inlet rate-limits that pubkey family for 6 epochs.
